text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A at a steep loss, but waiting just to avoid realizing losses is not a sound strategy; I should reassess each holding based on its prospects and risk, not my cost basis.","Selling Stocks B and E for gains was satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to exit; I should follow a consistent plan for position sizes and when to sell.","My account has moved sharply in both directions over these few periods, so I should avoid drawing big conclusions from short-term results and keep decisions grounded in diversification and long-term risk."]}
